feed.title: NPR Topics: World
feed.subtitle: NPR world news, international art and culture, world business and financial markets, world economy, and global trends in health, science and technology. Subscribe to the World Story of the Day podcast and RSS feed.

entry.title: Sally Rooney's books will no longer be sold in U.K. after Palestinian Action support
entry.summary: The Irish author said her books can no longer be sold in the UK after she pledged the royalties to a banned pro-Palestinian group.

entry.title: Russia's view amid Ukraine's strikes and Zelenskyy's growing rift with the U.S.
entry.summary: Russian authorities say Ukraine struck a major oil refinery southeast of Moscow Thursday. The strike was in response to Russia's attacks on Ukrainian energy infrastructure.

entry.title: How Putin may react to the rift between the U.S. and Ukraine
entry.summary: Journalist and Russia analyst Julia Ioffe lays out how Vladimir Putin might be trying to exploit the current divide between the U.S. and Ukraine over striking Russian oil refineries.

entry.title: Social Security benefits to get a boost. And, Hasan Piker defends his rhetoric
entry.summary: Social Security benefits are set to get a boost to offset rising consumer prices. And, streamer Hasan Piker says the GOP's "guilt-by-association politics" won't drag Democrats down in the midterms.

entry.title: Ukraine resumes attacks on Russian oil refineries, officials say, after brief truce
entry.summary: Ukrainian drones attacked a refinery in Russia's Ryazan region early Thursday, hours after Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said that a brief truce spurned by Moscow was over.

entry.title: Greetings from Mexico City, where a bullfighting ban doesn't stop this matador training
entry.summary: One plays the bull, the other the bullfighter, as a pair practices a dance of death in a sport that's prohibited in the Mexican capital city.

entry.title: Ukraine says its Starshield access is back
entry.summary: Ukraine says its access to SpaceX's Starshield has been restored. It's the system the country uses for its offensive drone attacks on Russia.

entry.title: Rep. Mike Quigley, D-Ill., on reports Ukraine's Starshield access was restricted
entry.summary: NPR's Michel Martin speaks with Democratic Rep. Mike Quigley of Illinois about reports that SpaceX temporarily restricted access to its Starshield in Ukraine, affecting the country's war efforts.

entry.title: School roof collapse kills at least 29, injures more than 3 dozen in Pakistan
entry.summary: The roof of a private school collapsed in northwestern Pakistan on Thursday, killing at least 28 children and a female teacher and injuring more than 50 other people.

entry.title: Aboard an icebreaker, a writer got a closer look at the Arctic's 'Sea Change'
entry.summary: As polar ice melts in the Arctic, shipping lanes are opening up, making the region a new zone of superpower competition. Writer Rana Foroohar explains the stakes in Sea Change.
